description:
FAR 12.202(b)(l)(i) "This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. The intent is to award a  "sole source", fixed price contract to Carver Pump Co. 


This solicitation is issued as a RFQ for parts for the #2, #5, & #6 AC Seawater Pump Systems on a US Vessell. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov
